article_angle: Родитель снял квартиру на 3 ночи для сына-первокурсника. В объявлении «рядом с вузом» оказалось 40 минут пешком до нужного корпуса. Сначала нужно проверить маршрут до точного адреса корпуса, затем оплачивать.

cover.composition: split route-map poster. Left side: parent and teenage son on a sunny bench near a Tyumen campus avenue, two suitcases and backpack visible. Right side: oversized smartphone mockup showing a 40-minute walking route in 2GIS toward the exact university building, beside a torn rental listing claiming «5 мин до вуза». A bold editorial headline bridges the two halves. Gold tape route arrows and a printed campus map create a tactile collage.

cover.generation_prompt: Create a high-key WOW magazine poster cover about checking the exact route to a university building before paying for a short-term rental. Split route-map collage: a practical parent and first-year student with two suitcases sit on a sunny bench on a Tyumen campus avenue in late August; green linden trees, warm morning sun, distant university facade. Opposite them, a large smartphone mockup displays a clear 2GIS-style 40-minute walking route to the exact building, next to a torn rental advertisement claiming «5 мин до вуза». Add printed campus map, gold tape route arrows, backpack with documents folder, and a tiny Drake reaction sticker at bottom-left. Editorial gold-black-white typography with the exact headline «Проверьте путь до корпуса», highlighted word «путь», sticky note «Сначала маршрут», and the three exact Wordstat stickers. Leave a clean 8-12% top-right pad for the official Добрый дом logo reference, with no backing plate. Summer only, no snow, no winter, no host, no phone number, no WordPress UI.
